introHtml: Neon drawstring backpacks turn your logo into a high-visibility statement at concerts, corporate runs, and campus events. The bright color ensures your brand stands out in crowds and low-light settings, making them a smart choice for safety managers and marketing directors alike. These lightweight packs work well with screen printing or heat transfer decoration, and the cinch closure keeps contents secure. Order bulk neon backpacks for giveaways, safety kits, or event swag that attendees will actually use.
